text:
maria: Quick heads-up from nightly reranker PTQ: rbrk-v2-small + awq-perhead on runtime kvpack-v3 shows huge MRR regressions on 1-token queries. Overall NDCG fine but single-token slice tanked. Anyone free to help triage?

jon: Ouch. Can you share the eval command + seed? Also did candidate pool change?

maria: `./scripts/eval_rerank.py --model rbrk-v2-small --quant awq-perhead --runtime kvpack-v3 --split webqa-holdout --seed 11` Candidate pool unchanged.

rik: Two quick possibilities: per-head scaling interacting with packed KV layout, or an off-by-one in offsets for tiny sequences.

sarah: Can you compute pairwise rank-flip rate fp16 vs int8 for qlen==1? That usually tells the story.

maria: Flip-rate ~= 0.44 on 1200 samples. For qlen>=3 it's ~0.07.

jon: Yep that matches ordering instability, not just score scaling. Try two cheap tests: 1) run awq-perhead on kvpack-v2 2) pad all inputs to length 5 before encoding. If either recovers, points to kv offsets.

ci-bot: Started job rerank/2250009999-a (v2-awq-perhead) and rerank/2250009999-b (pad-5-awq-perhead).

ci-bot: Job rerank/2250009999-a finished: qlen=1 MRR 0.61 (baseline fp16 0.63). Job rerank/2250009999-b finished: qlen=1 MRR 0.60.

rik: So runtime switch or padding both recover. Root cause likely interaction between awq-perhead and kvpack-v3 offsets for very short sequences. I'll open an issue with repro.

sarah: Short-term mitigation: pin kvpack-v2 for the canary and add a CI smoke that slices qlen==1/2 and asserts within tolerance vs fp16. Also add note to onboarding doc to try pad-to-5 if triage needed.

maria: Done — canary pinned and PR open to add the qlen slices to smokebench. Filing runtime bug now.

jon: Action items: rik -> runtime repro + unit test for zero/short-seq offsets. sarah -> CI slice and onboarding note. maria -> patch canary and follow-up in bringup doc.

maria: Thanks all. Lesson learned: tiny query slices catch weird quant+runtime interactions early. :white_check_mark:
